text_en: Water puppetry is a traditional art from the north of Vietnam.
It started in villages hundreds of years ago.
Farmers used to perform shows on ponds and lakes after the rice harvest.
The puppets are made of wood, and they are painted in bright colours.
The puppeteers stand behind a curtain in the water.
They use long sticks under the water to move the puppets.
Musicians play traditional instruments, and singers tell the story.
The audience loves the funny stories about farmers, animals and dragons.
If you visit Hanoi, you should watch a water puppet show!
